EC1: Primary groups [AND]: Vaccination against typhoid fever within 5 years before dosing.
EC2: History of clinical typhoid fever [OR], clinical paratyphoid A [OR] or B fever.
EC3: Immunization with [OR] any other vaccine (oral [OR] or parenteral) within 4 weeks prior to study start or planned vaccination during the study
EC4: Current intake of antibiotics [OR] or end of antibiotic therapy <8 days before first IMP administration
EC5: Chronic (longer than 14 days) administration of immunosuppressants [OR] or other immune-modifying drugs [AND] within 6 months before the first dose of investigational vaccine; [NOT] oral corticosteroids in dosages of =0.5 mg/kg/d prednisolone or equivalent are excluded; inhaled or topical steroids are allowed
EC6: Acute [OR] or chronic clinically significant gastrointestinal disease
